t: He, or it, passed; passed away; went;
pressed onward, with a penetrative energy
a sharpness and effectiveness, in his pace.
the saying, was effectual; had effect; was, or became, executed, or performed;
with penetrative energy, or with sharpness, vigour, and effectiveness, in the affair;
to take effect; executed it; performed it.
He made the oath to be unconditional, without exception, absolutely
He made his covenant, or contract, or the like, to have,
take, effect; executed or performed it.
and so rendered it effective. ― -b7- See 1.
Penetrating, sharp, energetic, or acting with penetrative energy, or vigorous, and effective, in the performing of affairs:
, &c., and implies penetration and skill, or proficiency in anything;]

A command, or an order, that is effectual; that has effect; that is executed, or performed;
That was in the time that is past;
One who performs affairs with energy and perseverance:

maqayis: الميم والضاد والحرف المعتل أصل صحيح يدل على نفاذ ومرور. ومضى يمضي مضيا. والمضاء: النفاذ في الأمر. والمضواء: التقدم.
قال القطامي: فإذا خنسن مضى على مضوائه.
mufradat: المضي والمضاء: النفاذ، ويقال ذلك في الأعيان والأحداث. قال تعالى: ومضى مثل الأولين [الزخرف/ 8] ، فقد مضت سنت الأولين [الأنفال/ 38] .
